remarks: If your perfect home is all about location and low-maintenance living, this 1 bedroom, 1 bath condo delivers. Freshly painted and move-in ready, it's perched in a well kept high rise with plenty of perks, a sparkling pool for summer lounging, a playground, community gym, and off street parking. But I'm getting ahead of myself. This condo offers taste and luxury with stunning hardwood floors, over sized patio and a walk in closet fit for a city queen. Laundry day? Easy. The building's laundry room is right in the basement. Just a short ride in the brand new elevators.  But here's the real magic: you can stroll to just about everything. Schools, the Ferguson Library, downtown restaurants, shops, coffee spots, and the Tully Health Center are all just a short walk away. Whether you're meeting friends, running errands, or catching a workout, you can leave the car behind.  It's the kind of spot that keeps life simple and fun so you can spend less time commuting and more time doing what you love.  Unit includes storage in the basement as well as 1 assigned parking spot with additional spots available for a fee.
